completed_with_distinction.authorialMeaning: A trusted synthetic category-local positive result, with no authored first/second/third place or numeric award strength.
completed_with_distinction.reason: The original generic distinction does not identify participation, prize or win. Mapping it to any one of those would invent an outcome.
completed_with_distinction.requiredHandling: Keep the original case and labels. Report unsupported FSP outcome coverage explicitly. If useful, publish separate clearly named sensitivity variants for participation/prize/win (+1/+2/+3), with unchanged labels; none is the authored primary result.

claimed_distinction.authorialMeaning: An untrusted self-claim, never a trusted provider result.
claimed_distinction.requiredHandling: Retain as an untrusted claim. Do not map to a trusted achievement.

limits: This clarification fixes meaning only; it does not alter frozen needs, candidate facts, business relevance labels, eligibility rules or scores. Prior policy exposure remains as disclosed in the original rubric.
